name: generate
description: Start any Studio workflow. Use list_models for its prompt, options, and inputSlots. If uploadRequired is returned, call upload_asset for every file slot and submit on the final upload. Set maxCredits to the spend the user approved; Studio refuses a costlier quote without charging.

maxCredits.description: Most credits this call may spend. Studio refuses, reserving nothing, when the locked quote costs more, and returns that quote for approval.

modelId.description: Model id from list_models, e.g. flux-schnell

options.description: Model option values declared by list_models

prompt.description: Creative prompt when the model declares a text slot

wait.description: If true, poll until completed/failed for up to 120 s. Remote connections return the generationId immediately; follow up with wait_generation.
